title: GHO.ZEN
tagline: Widget button to embed on sites and pay with GHO. Easy to embed
description:
GHO.ZEN is a widget that you can embed on any website and enjoy the convenience of GHO stablekoin when paying for purchases and different things

Widget is a reactive component that can be implemented on any site and be sure that everything will work well

It works in conjunction with ConnectKit, so be sure to install it in the dependencies
how_its_made:
I've made a react component and a ribbon to demonstrate how the component works

Landing made with Next.js, React

Also used GHO and sepolia testnet
